# _Pack Synopsis_
_Ashes to Ashes_ is a resource pack that changes the visuals of the Wither.

### 


## _Wither Storm_
By right-clicking a wither with a name-tag renamed ```Wither Storm```, the wither will gain a command block inside of its ribcage. The Wither Storm Variant may not work properly with shaders.
